description: This PHP file is a script for comparing different revisions of requirement specifications within the TestLink project. It loads necessary dependencies, defines functions to retrieve and compare requirement revision data, and manages the display of diff outputs between selected requirement revisions.

methods.name: getItemsToCompare
methods.description: Retrieves the two requirement items to compare based on their IDs from a set of items.

methods.name: getCFToCompare
methods.description: Gets linked custom fields of the requirement items for comparison.

methods.name: getCFDiff
methods.description: Computes differences between custom fields of two requirement items, considering configuration settings.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves argument parameters from request and session data for the comparison process.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI structure for displaying the comparison, truncating logs as per configuration.

methods.name: prepareUserFeedback
methods.description: Prepares the labels and revision IDs for displaying feedback about the compared requirement revisions.

methods.name: getAttrDiff
methods.description: Compares key attributes (like document ID, name, type) between two requirement sides and notes changes.
